headline: Wheeler wins 11th as Phillies complete sweep of Angels
recap: The Phillies completed a three-game sweep of the Angels on Sunday afternoon in Anaheim, winning 5-2. Los Angeles led 1-0 after Mike Trout's RBI double in the first, but Zack Wheeler settled in and allowed nothing else over six innings, striking out six to improve to 11-5. Philadelphia tied it in the third and took the lead in the seventh before breaking it open with two runs in the eighth and one more in the ninth. J.T. Realmuto and Edmundo Sosa each hit solo home runs, Realmuto's 10th of the season and Sosa's seventh, while Brandon Marsh, Bryce Harper and pinch-hitter Luis Arraez each drove in a run. Orion Kerkering worked the final 1.1 innings for his second save, allowing the Angels' other run on a ninth-inning double. Yusei Kikuchi took the loss for Los Angeles.

The sweep extended Philadelphia's winning streak to four games. The Phillies are 77-60, second in the NL East, five games behind the division-leading Braves, and sit comfortably in position for a National League Wild Card spot, 4.5 games clear of the cutoff line.

Philadelphia opens a three-game series at Arizona tonight, with Aaron Nola starting against a Diamondbacks staff that has not yet announced a probable pitcher. First pitch at Chase Field is scheduled for 9:40 PM ET.
